name: Raycasting with Bricking and Phong Shading
definition: A CPU-based raycasting algorithm for volume rendering that uses a brick-based data layout for acceleration, computes gradients for Phong shading, and accumulates color and opacity using front-to-back blending.
summary: A CPU-based volume rendering algorithm that accelerates raycasting with fixed-size bricks and distinguishes itself by integrating Phong shading and gradient calculation directly into the ray loop.
